# Float Cancellation

Exhaust 1.5.5, release build. 100 runs on seeds 1337–1436; 100 failures.

[Raw results](../failures/floatCancellation.json). Dependency revision: `c7dbb96f2c713e463cd284b41db92d478799b61c`.

| Metric | Mean | Median |
|---|---:|---:|
| Reduction invocations | 306.0 | 267.5 |
| Original input length | 39.5 | 40.0 |
| Wall time (ms) | 0.619 | 0.534 |
| generation (ms) | 0.007 | 0.006 |
| reductions (ms) | 0.580 | 0.500 |
| total (ms) | 0.613 | 0.529 |

The main README adds the original failing call to generated-run evaluation counts; fixed-start counts are used directly.
